name: AMRUT (Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
renamedFrom: Jawaharlal Nehru National Urban Renewal Mission
description: Mission to establish infrastructure to ensure basic services including water supply, sewerage, urban transport to households and build amenities in cities.

name: Aspirational Districts Programme
description: Programme to quickly and effectively transform the most underdeveloped districts of India across 5 thematic areas: health, education, agriculture, financial inclusion, and infrastructure.

name: Atal Bhujal Yojana
description: Scheme for sustainable groundwater management with community participation in water-stressed areas. Focuses on demand-side interventions and community behaviour change.

name: Atal Pension Yojana
description: Government-backed pension scheme for unorganised sector workers guaranteeing pension of Rs 1,000–5,000 per month from age 60, depending on contribution.

name: Ayushman Bharat – PM Jan Arogya Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: World's largest health insurance scheme providing health cover of Rs 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization. Renamed from RSBY.

name: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Mission to develop a national digital health ecosystem that supports universal health coverage. Creates a Health ID (ABHA) for every citizen linking all health records digitally.

name: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: National programme to address the declining Child Sex Ratio and promote the welfare of girl children. Launched in Panipat, Haryana.

name: Bharatmala Pariyojana
ministry: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
description: Umbrella programme for highways development focusing on optimising efficiency of freight and passenger movement across India through development of Economic Corridors.

name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Gram Jyoti Yojana (DDUGJY)
description: Scheme for rural electrification focusing on feeder separation of agricultural and domestic supply, strengthening sub-transmission and distribution infrastructure in rural areas.

name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)
description: Skill training and placement programme for rural youth from poor families. Aims to diversify incomes of rural families and cater to career aspirations of rural youth.

name: Digital India Programme
ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
description: Flagship programme to transform India into a digitally empowered society and knowledge economy. Covers digital infrastructure, digital services, and digital literacy.

name: e-SHRAM Portal
description: National database of unorganised workers to facilitate their access to social security benefits. Provides a Universal Account Number to each registered unorganised worker.

name: eNAM (National Agriculture Market)
description: Pan-India electronic trading portal for agricultural commodities providing a single window service for all APMC related information and services. Enables farmers to get better prices through online competitive bidding.

name: Jal Jeevan Mission
description: Mission to provide safe and adequate drinking water through tap connections to all rural households by 2024. Renamed from NRDWP.

name: Jan Dhan Yojana
description: National mission for financial inclusion to ensure access to financial services like banking, savings, remittance, credit, insurance and pension.

name: Khelo India Programme
ministry: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports
description: Programme to revive sports culture at grassroots level in India. Identifies and trains talented young athletes with scholarships and world-class training.

name: Mahatma Gandhi NREGS (BJP era continuation)
description: Continuation and implementation of the MGNREGS Act under BJP government. Provides at least 100 days of guaranteed wage employment per year to adult members of rural households who demand unskilled manual work.

name: Make in India
ministry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade
description: Initiative to facilitate investment, foster innovation, enhance skill development, protect intellectual property, and build best-in-class manufacturing infrastructure.

name: Mission Indradhanush
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Immunisation programme to cover all children under 2 years and pregnant women who are either unvaccinated or partially vaccinated against 12 vaccine-preventable diseases.

name: Namami Gange Programme
description: Integrated conservation mission to accomplish effective abatement of pollution, conservation and rejuvenation of the Ganga river.

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
description: Scheme to promote apprenticeship training in India by sharing 25% of prescribed stipend with employers for fresh apprentices. Target: 50 lakh apprentices by 2020.

name: National Health Mission
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Umbrella mission encompassing National Rural Health Mission (NRHM) and National Urban Health Mission (NUHM). Continued and expanded under BJP government.

name: PM Daksh Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Scheme for upskilling of marginalised youth — SCs, OBCs, EBCs, DNTs, and sanitation workers. Provides short-term and long-term skill training with stipend and placement support.

name: PM Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
description: Free food grain scheme launched during COVID-19 pandemic providing additional 5 kg grain per person per month free of cost to NFSA beneficiaries. Extended multiple times, now merged with NFSA from 2023.

name: PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan
description: Digital platform to bring 16 ministries together for integrated planning and coordinated implementation of infrastructure connectivity projects. Aims to reduce logistics cost.

name: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
description: Life insurance scheme offering Rs 2 lakh cover on death from any cause at a premium of Rs 330/year, renewable annually.

name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: Direct income support scheme providing Rs 6,000 per year in three equal installments to small and marginal farmer families.

name: PM Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan (PM KUSUM)
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
description: Scheme to add solar power generation capacity in rural areas, solarise agricultural pump sets, and install grid-connected solar power plants for farmers.

name: PM Krishi Sinchai Yojana (PMKSY)
description: Integrated irrigation scheme with motto "Har Khet Ko Pani, More Crop Per Drop". Consolidates existing irrigation schemes under one umbrella for end-to-end irrigation supply chain.

name: PM Poshan Shakti Nirman (Mid-Day Meal Scheme)
description: Renamed from Mid-Day Meal Scheme, provides free hot cooked meals to students in government schools. Enhanced to include breakfast in aspirational districts.

name: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana
description: Accident insurance scheme offering Rs 2 lakh cover for accidental death and full disability, Rs 1 lakh for partial disability at a premium of Rs 12/year.

name: PM SVANidhi (PM Street Vendor AtmaNirbhar Nidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Micro-credit scheme for street vendors to help them resume livelihoods after COVID-19 lockdowns. Provides collateral-free working capital loans with incentives for digital transactions.

name: PM Ujjwala Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
renamedFrom: Rajiv Gandhi Gramin LPG Vitaran Yojana
description: Scheme to provide free LPG connections to women from BPL households. Aims to replace unclean cooking fuels with clean LPG.

name: PMAY (Gramin) – PM Awas Yojana Rural
description: Separate from PMAY Urban. Provides financial assistance to rural BPL households to construct pucca houses with basic amenities including toilet, LPG connection, electricity.

name: POSHAN Abhiyaan (National Nutrition Mission)
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: Government's flagship programme to improve nutritional outcomes for children, pregnant women and lactating mothers. Uses technology and Jan Andolan approach.

name: Pradhan Mantri Annadata Aay SanraksHan Abhiyan (PM-AASHA)
description: Scheme to ensure farmers get Minimum Support Price (MSP) for their produce. Comprises Price Support Scheme, Price Deficiency Payment Scheme, and Pilot of Private Procurement.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Aims to provide affordable housing to urban poor through financial assistance. Previously known as Rajiv Awas Yojana and Indira Awas Yojana in its rural form.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
description: Crop insurance scheme providing financial support to farmers suffering crop loss/damage due to unforeseen events. Replaced NAIS and MNAIS.

name: Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (Phase III)
description: Provides all-weather road connectivity to unconnected habitations in rural areas. Phase III focuses on consolidation and upgradation of existing rural roads.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Aushadhi Pariyojana (PMJAP)
description: Scheme to make quality generic medicines available at affordable prices through dedicated retail stores called Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Kendras (PMBJKs) across the country.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
description: India's flagship demand-driven skill certification scheme, now in its fourth phase (2022–26). Trains youth in industry-relevant short-term courses (STT) and certifies existing workers through Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL). Run through a network of NSDC-accredited training centres and Skill India Digital Hub.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: Maternity benefit programme providing cash incentive of Rs 5,000 to pregnant and lactating mothers for the first live birth to partly compensate for wage loss and improve health seeking behaviour.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana
renamedFrom: Self Employment and Talent Utilization (SETU) Scheme
description: Provides loans up to Rs 10 lakh to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises. Three products: Shishu (up to 50k), Kishore (50k-5L), Tarun (5L-10L).

name: Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana
description: Pension scheme for senior citizens providing assured pension/interest income at 7.4% per annum for 10 years. Managed by LIC of India with government subsidy.

name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme
description: Scheme to give companies incentives on incremental sales from products manufactured in India over a base year. Covers 14 key sectors including electronics, pharma, autos.

name: Sagarmala Programme
ministry: Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways
description: Programme for port-led development to reduce logistics cost for EXIM and domestic trade with minimal infrastructure investment through optimum utilization of waterways.

name: Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan
description: Integrated scheme for school education extending from pre-school to Class 12. Treats school education holistically without segmentation.

name: Saubhagya (Pradhan Mantri Sahaj Bijli Har Ghar Yojana)
description: Scheme to provide electricity connections to all un-electrified households in rural areas and poor households in urban areas. Replaced RGGVY.

name: Shyama Prasad Mukherji Rurban Mission
description: Mission to stimulate local economic development, enhance basic services, and create well-planned Rurban clusters (rural areas with urban amenities) to bridge rural-urban divide.

name: Smart Cities Mission
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
renamedFrom: Jawaharlal Nehru National Urban Renewal Mission (JNNURM)
description: Mission to develop 100 smart cities as models of urban development for the rest of India through area-based development and pan-city initiatives.

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Scheme to issue Soil Health Cards to farmers carrying crop-wise nutrient recommendations based on soil test results, to promote balanced use of fertilisers and improve soil health.

name: Stand Up India
description: Scheme to facilitate bank loans between Rs 10 lakh and Rs 1 crore to at least one SC/ST borrower and one woman borrower per bank branch for greenfield enterprises.

name: Startup India
ministry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade
description: Initiative to build a strong ecosystem for nurturing innovation and startups in India, drive sustainable economic growth and generate employment.

name: Swachh Bharat Mission (Gramin)
description: Rural component of the Swachh Bharat Mission aiming to eliminate open defecation in rural India through construction of individual household toilets (IHHLs) and behaviour change.

name: Swachh Bharat Mission (Urban)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Flagship sanitation programme launched on 2 October 2014. Aims to eliminate open defecation and improve solid waste management in urban areas.

name: Swamitva Scheme
description: Scheme to provide property rights to residents of rural areas of India by mapping land parcels using drone technology. Provides property cards to households.

name: UDAN (Ude Desh ka Aam Naagrik)
description: Regional connectivity scheme to make air travel affordable for common citizens and connect tier-2 and tier-3 cities. Uses viability gap funding for airlines.
